query: Can I still receive top-ups if I have started my monthly retirement payouts?
reference_answer: Yes, you can receive top-ups as long as you have not reached thecurrent Enhanced Retirement Sum.Find outhow much top-ups you can receive.

answer: Yes, you can receive top-ups as long as you haven't reached the current Enhanced Retirement Sum (ERS). However, there are restrictions like needing to make the top-up by 31 December of the year you're eligible for the Matched Retirement Savings Scheme (MRSS) grant. Additionally, cash top-ups can earn up to 6% interest annually and offer tax relief of up to $16,000 per year. [Document 2]
